title: Home Assistant action <ns>.control (fields)
description: Integration action that switches on behalf of a device. Allowed for every authenticated user, but only device users of the integration (decided by their rule snapshot), admins and system calls get anything executed; others get not_a_device. Executes as the system with the caller's context as parent (the logbook names the device user). Called by apps over the HA WebSocket (call_service domain <ns>, service control, service_data = this object, return_response true) or REST POST /api/services/<ns>/control?return_response. A single entity that is rejected raises ServiceValidationError (translation_domain <ns>, translation_key = $defs/control_denial_reason, placeholders entity_id, until); a batch (entity_ids) executes what is allowed and reports per entity in the answer (without return_response a partly rejected batch raises control_partly_denied after executing the allowed ones). check_only evaluates without executing (always with return_response; for greying out and as health check). Allowed actions and fields: data/control-allowlist.json. entity_id and entity_ids are mutually exclusive (checked by tools/validate.py and the integration: not_allowed_field).

entity_ids.description: Batch of one action such as “all off”: what is allowed is executed, the answer reports per entity. Not together with entity_id.

action.description: Action of the entity's own domain, e.g. turn_on (light.turn_on for light.x).

data.description: Action data without target keys; every key must be allowed for the domain and action.

check_only.description: Evaluate only, execute nothing. Missing = false.

grant.description: Only the hub, for child devices: pre-authorization it already counted; forwarded unchanged in POST /api/integration/kids-check.
